# ZH1C

> 1C:Enterprise 8.3 configuration extension `Ж` with reusable server-side helpers: event log, dates, strings, JSON, additional attributes and ЗУП lookups.

ZH1C contains the extension `Ж` (object prefix `Ж_`, purpose AddOn, compatibility mode 8.3.11) as a built `Ж.cfe` and as a Designer XML/BSL dump in `src/cfe/Ж`. Its common modules `Ж_ext` and `Ж_ЗУП` export server-only functions that other 1C code calls; the data processor `Ж_ДопРеквизиты` reads and writes БСП additional attributes.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/WonderMr/ZH1C/blob/main/README.md): what the extension contains, requirements and usage
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/WonderMr/ZH1C/blob/main/AGENTS.md): layout, rebuild notes, conventions and gotchas for coding agents

## Source

- [Ж_ext](https://github.com/WonderMr/ZH1C/blob/main/src/cfe/Ж/CommonModules/Ж_ext/Ext/Module.bsl): general helper functions
- [Ж_ЗУП](https://github.com/WonderMr/ZH1C/blob/main/src/cfe/Ж/CommonModules/Ж_ЗУП/Ext/Module.bsl): person and user lookups
- [Ж_ДопРеквизиты](https://github.com/WonderMr/ZH1C/blob/main/src/cfe/Ж/DataProcessors/Ж_ДопРеквизиты/Ext/ManagerModule.bsl): additional-attribute storage
- [Configuration.xml](https://github.com/WonderMr/ZH1C/blob/main/src/cfe/Ж/Configuration.xml): extension properties and version
